Name: Gigantic Coop and Barn
Author: bobkalonger
Description:
[center][b][color=#ff7700][size=5]!! Check out my entry for Modfest 2026: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44285]Ultimate Coop and Barn[/url]﻿ !![/size][/color]﻿[/b][/center]
[b]
UPDATE: No longer requires Jen's Mega Coop and Barn! Added compatibility with vanilla AND with Resource Chickens!
[/b]Compatible with the following setups:
[list]
[*]Vanilla[/*]
[*]Jen's Mega Coop and Barn[/*]
[*]Vanilla + Resource Chickens[/*]
[*]Jen's Mega Coop and Barn + Resource Chickens[/*]
[*]More Upgrades by Amichwan (in this mod's config, please set Appearance to Compatible, otherwise the textures will be wrong!!)[/*]
[/list][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43227]Warm Stalls and Cozy Boxes[/url] has built in compatibility with this mod, adding some realism to the interiors! Check out the modpage for how to use them together. Thanks lindest!!

Is mega still not enough? Do you want to have a silly amount of animals in one building? Well, for some reason, I did, so I made this mod.

Gigantic Coops and Barns will hold up to 40 animals each, with TWO rows of hay and plenty of room for some machines. I made the maps extremely clean (no hay piles or junk) with a regular floor and lighting pattern because of my personal preference. There is now a new config option to add some hay and a few objects if you prefer how it looks! The water sources ARE water sources, and the Giga Coop will now come with TWO extra incubators.

The building footprints and exterior appearance stay the same as the vanilla Deluxe Coop and Barn (just like the Mega Coop and Barn) so any recolors or reskins [i]should[/i] carry over. These buildings won't take up any more space but you're going to need more silos....or just a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21021]Bigger Silo Size[/url].

Giga Barn cost:
150000g
900 wood
700 stone
300 hardwood

Giga Coop cost
120000g
800 wood
600 stone
200 hardwood

See config options provided for compatibility with other mods!

Recolor mods like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27521]Coop and Barn Facelift Redux[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]VPR[/url] are compatible and highly recommended!!
[center]
